tests.name: root_value_exception_diagnostics_positions
tests.intent: Verify that root value exceptions include byte range when both JSON_DIAGNOSTICS and JSON_DIAGNOSTIC_POSITIONS are enabled.

tests.name: root_value_json_view_diagnostics_positions
tests.intent: Verify that json_view root value exceptions include byte range when diagnostic positions and diagnostics are active.

tests.name: nested_value_exception_diagnostics_positions
tests.intent: Verify that nested value exceptions continue to show both path and byte range with both options enabled.

tests.name: constructed_root_value_no_positions
tests.intent: Verify that programmatically constructed root values (not parsed) do not produce stray byte ranges or whitespace.

tests.name: value_initialized_iterator_exception_guard
tests.intent: Verify that value-initialized iterator comparisons or operations do not crash when checking diagnostics on null elements.

tests.name: json_view_not_found_value_path
tests.intent: Verify that json_view exception handling correctly processes a value path that is not found, leaving no stray tokens.

tests.name: root_value_diagnostics_only
tests.intent: Verify root exception output when only JSON_DIAGNOSTICS is enabled (no byte positions).

tests.name: root_value_positions_only
tests.intent: Verify root exception output when only JSON_DIAGNOSTIC_POSITIONS is enabled.

tests.name: editable_json_document_root_exception
tests.intent: Verify json_editable_document root exception message format with both options set.

tests.name: object_root_field_exception
tests.intent: Verify object root element access failure exception messages with both macros enabled.

tests.name: array_root_element_exception
tests.intent: Verify array root element type error exception formatting.

tests.name: string_root_element_exception
tests.intent: Verify string root element conversion exception formatting.

tests.name: nested_deep_path_exception
tests.intent: Verify deeply nested path formatting with byte positions.

tests.name: json_view_nested_error
tests.intent: Verify json_view nested error diagnostics output.

tests.name: escaped_key_path_exception
tests.intent: Verify that escaped keys in paths correctly retain byte ranges for nested errors.

tests.name: patch_inplace_root_diagnostic
tests.intent: Verify exception path and byte range during patch_inplace when an error occurs at the root.

tests.name: push_back_error_diagnostic
tests.intent: Verify exception diagnostics on push_back operations with diagnostic positions enabled.

tests.name: erase_iterator_diagnostic
tests.intent: Verify diagnostics behavior when erasing invalid iterator positions.

tests.name: update_error_diagnostic
tests.intent: Verify exception diagnostics when updating a primitive root with an object.

tests.name: json_view_number_token_error
tests.intent: Verify json_view number_token error diagnostics for root values.
